responsibility: Holds crate-root unit-test scaffolding for `rustc_middle`. In practice this file provides the minimal test entry needed to force linkage against `rustc_data_structures` on Windows, ensuring the crate’s test binary pulls in required imported symbols despite the platform-specific `dllimport` issue.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the module-local `tests.rs` files under `mir/interpret/allocation` and `util/common`, this crate-root `tests.rs` is not testing a subsystem API at all; it exists only as a crate-level linkage shim that calls into `rustc_data_structures` so the `rustc_middle` test binary links correctly on Windows.
